title: Why the Air Quality Is So Bad Today Across the Bay Area and Central Valley
description: Air quality is poor today across the Bay Area and Central Valley. High pressure and fog are trapping pollution near the ground. See what is causing it and who is most at risk.

pages.title: Why Is the Air So Bad Today?
pages.description: Bay Area and California Valley are facing unhealthy air conditions today.

pages.title: Air quality is poor across the Bay Area and Central Valley today.
pages.description: Weather conditions are stopping pollution from moving away.

pages.title: Why Pollution Is Getting Trapped?
pages.description: A strong high pressure system is sitting over the region. It pushes air downward and keeps pollution close to the ground.

pages.title: No Wind No Relief
pages.description: There is very little wind to clear the air. Cold air pulls smoke and pollutants even lower.

pages.title: Valley Fog Making Things Worse
pages.description: Dense Valley fog is covering parts of Central California. The fog holds dust smoke and dirty air near the surface.

pages.title: Health Risks Are Increasing
pages.description: Tiny particles enter the lungs and move into the bloodstream. Children older adults and people with breathing problems are at higher risk.

pages.title: Wood Smoke Adds To Pollution
pages.description: Cold weather leads many homes to use fireplaces for warmth. Wood smoke builds up when the air does not move.

pages.title: Spare The Air Alert Is Active
pages.description: A Spare the Air alert is in effect in the Bay Area until Saturday. Burning wood indoors or outdoors is not allowed during this time.

pages.title: Rules And Penalties
pages.description: People who break the rules may face warnings or fines. Repeated violations can lead to higher penalties.

pages.title: What You Can Do Today?
pages.description: Avoid heavy outdoor activity. Keep doors and windows closed.  Use clean indoor air if possible.

pages.title: When Will Air Improve
pages.description: Weather experts say air quality may improve next week. Until then hazy skies will remain.

pages.title: Stay Aware Stay Safe
pages.description: Check daily air quality updates. Small actions can help protect your health.
